# pbs_s3_endpoint (Data Source)

Reads a Proxmox Backup Server S3 endpoint, without its secret key, which PBS never returns. It does not contact the object store: `pbs_s3_buckets` does. Needs `Sys.Audit` on `/system/s3-endpoint/<id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_s3_endpoint" "aws" {
  id = "aws"
}

# Backups to S3 are to leave bandwidth for the rest; warn when someone
# removed the endpoint's upload limit.
check "s3_uploads_are_limited" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.pbs_s3_endpoint.aws.rate_out != null
    error_message = "S3 endpoint aws has no rate_out: backups to S3 may take the whole uplink."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the S3 endpoint to read, such as `backblaze`.

### Read-Only

- `access_key` (String, Sensitive) Access key ID PBS signs its requests with.
- `burst_in` (String) How many bytes over `rate_in` PBS may download at once, as PBS writes it, such as `10 MiB`; null for as much as `rate_in`.
- `burst_out` (String) How many bytes over `rate_out` PBS may upload at once, as PBS writes it, such as `10 MiB`; null for as much as `rate_out`.
- `endpoint` (String) Host name or IP address of the object store, possibly with `{{bucket}}` and `{{region}}`.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate PBS accepts besides those its CAs validate, as colon-separated lower-case hex pairs; null when there is none.
- `limit_active_requests` (Number) How many `PUT`, `POST` and `DELETE` requests a second PBS sends at most; null for no limit.
- `limit_passive_requests` (Number) How many `GET` and `HEAD` requests a second PBS sends at most; null for no limit.
- `path_style` (Boolean) Whether PBS addresses a bucket in the path of its requests rather than in the host name.
- `port` (Number) Port of the object store; null for 443.
- `provider_quirks` (Set of String) Features of the S3 API the object store lacks, which PBS works around; null for none.
- `rate_in` (String) Rate limit on downloads, in bytes per second, as PBS writes it, such as `10 MiB`; null for no limit.
- `rate_out` (String) Rate limit on uploads, in bytes per second, as PBS writes it, such as `10 MiB`; null for no limit.
- `region` (String) Region; null for `us-west-1`.
- `use_node_proxy` (Boolean) Whether PBS connects through the HTTP proxy of its node configuration.
